description: host, dates, winner, runner-up and team count are all recorded
verified match count is stored on the tournament
start date is not after end date
number_of_teams equals the distinct teams that appear as team1/team2 in matches
the recorded winner is the winner of the Final match
no other match has the same date and the same two teams
toss decision is recorded for played matches
a decisive result (not a tie or walkover) has a winner_id
a tie decided by super over / boundary count / eliminator stores the winner in winner_id
player of the match is recorded for played matches
match date lies within the tournament's start and end dates
team1 and team2 are different teams
result_type is RESULT, NO RESULT or ABANDONED
toss decision is bat or field
match_stage is a specific stage, not the catch-all 'Other'
note: 'Other' holds Super Six / quarterfinal matches; fixed by a stage taxonomy in Stage 4

description: winner_id is one of the two teams playing
toss_winner_id is one of the two teams playing
a played match (not a walkover) has innings
ball_by_ball_status is 'complete' exactly when deliveries exist
the winner's team name starts the result text (e.g. 'India won by ...')
note: name-format differences ('U.S.A.' vs 'United States of America') cause false positives; alias team ids (name = id) also fail here

description: a chasing innings stores its target
total runs are present and not negative
note: failures are super-over innings whose totals were never stored (derivable from deliveries)

description: batting and bowling team are different
legal deliveries (excluding wides and no-balls) do not exceed 300 (ODI) or 120 (T20)
batting and bowling team are the two teams of the match
total = sum of batting-scorecard runs + extras
total = sum of delivery runs (matches with ball-by-ball)
wickets = number of wicket deliveries (matches with ball-by-ball)
note: retired-out and similar dismissals may legitimately differ

description: the chasing team is the team that bowled first

note: rain-adjusted (DLS) targets legitimately differ; no DLS flag exists in the data

description: batter, extra and total runs are present and not negative
over number is within the format (1-based: ODI 1-50, T20 1-20)
batter and non-striker are different players
total runs = batter runs + extra runs
legal_ball_number is blank exactly for wides (project definition numbers no-balls as balls faced)
note: legal_ball_number counts no-balls, so it is NOT balls bowled; use is_wide/is_no_ball for overs

description: extras_type is set exactly when extra runs were scored
a wicket delivery records the dismissal type and the dismissed player
a non-wicket delivery has no dismissal fields
no other player id shares this player's name (ESPN vs Cricsheet ids)
note: exact-name matches only; initial-vs-full-name variants are not detected here

description: batting and bowling style are recorded
date of birth is between 1940 and 2012
a batting-scorecard player is in his team's squad for that tournament
note: squad lists can omit late replacements

description: every team referenced by a match exists and has a real name (not its id)
note: alias ids such as espn_32 / espn_34 (Nepal / Uganda) fail here

description: short name is an upper-case abbreviation of at most 4 characters
played matches have a batting scorecard

note: data is unavailable at every free source for T20 2007-2012, so this is a coverage gap, not a defect

description: every team that played has a squad for that tournament
tournament has award rows (player of the tournament etc.)
matches played = wins + losses + ties + no results
note: a tie settled by super over is credited as a win by the source

description: within a group, total wins = total losses
positions in a group are 1..n without gaps or repeats
a standings team actually played matches in that tournament
qualified flag is derived for every row
an active squad has exactly one captain
an active squad has at least 11 players
